purpose: Teach: バイヤー/打診/催促/充て/固める/アシスト/前文/一筋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外の、本気で、絶対、バイヤー、絶対、商談、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Push forward on that overseas buyer deal. Seriously. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Weight on each directive. Measured pace, no wasted breath. The tone of someone used to being obeyed, but not unkind about it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様、本気で、絶対、新規案件、絶対、打診、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've already reached out to our key clients about the new opportunity. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Steady, professional cadence. Each point lands with quiet confidence. Respectful without being servile. The report of someone who's already moving on the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 未払いの、本気で、絶対、催促、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure we follow up on those overdue payments. Handle it with care, but be firm. I need this moving.
lines.style: Direct and clear. Sharp emphasis on the stakes. Slower on 'care'—a quiet insistence on doing it right. Final phrase clipped short, showing impatience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の給与、本気で、絶対、来期、絶対、業績に、絶対、充てる、絶対、計画です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're allocating next quarter's budget to cover staff bonuses based on performance metrics. I wanted to flag that for you.
lines.style: Straightforward, slightly formal. A measured cadence that shows he's thought this through. Slight lift at the end—offering information he knows matters, without overselling it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約条件、本気で、絶対、固める、絶対、よう、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Those contract terms need to be locked down. Get that done. Don't leave room for negotiation once it's signed.
lines.style: Forceful opening. Sharp edges on each command. Steady pressure throughout. Final sentence lowers slightly—emphasis on finality, not threat.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の業務、本気で、絶対、アシスト、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our new staff member is getting full support on their tasks. Everyone's committed to bringing them up to speed properly.
lines.style: Reassuring tone beneath the formality. Steady pace, no hesitation. Slight warmth when mentioning the team's commitment—pride in the operation, not arrogance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書の、本気で、絶対、前文、絶対、修正、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the preamble section of that contract carefully. Make sure any revisions are accurate before we move forward.
lines.style: Precise, almost clinical. Each word placed deliberately. Slight emphasis on 'accurately'—this is where mistakes cost money. No room for haste.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、業務に、絶対、一筋に、絶対、取り組んでくれております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. The whole team is fully focused on their work. Everyone's giving their best effort. Thank you.
lines.style: Quiet confidence mixed with deference. A rhythm that shows respect without flinching. Final 'thank you' is genuine—brief, genuine acknowledgment of direction received.
